❯ #62 のゴーストテキスト誤検知を直して

● Fix complete and verified. Here's the summary.

  What was wrong (#62)

  When Claude Code's TUI input box shows ghost/placeholder text (or unsent typed text) like ❯ A で 3回試して,
  _has_input_prompt() only recognized a bare ❯ as a ready prompt. So c-lord misread an idle, ready prompt as
  "still busy" — the same ghost-text-as-real-input confusion the issue describes.

  Per the repo's DoD, this is a behavior change that still needs staging verification (RED reproduced + GREEN on
  staging) and a branch/PR before merge — those touch shared systems, so I haven't done them unprompted.
